decision: Check sibling branches with independent narrowing state. Preserve optimizer facts on a sibling path when a final register copy leaves by a different edge, invalidating the register at the actual join. Group optimizer control metadata in a record so the change has no instruction-count regression.

validation.quick: 453 passed in 11.32 s for the native control-record implementation; final full validation uses the independently bootstrapped/self-compiled compiler.
validation.coverage: Optional and union sibling arms, nested if expressions, match arms, if-let, reachable and prior invalidations, breaks, scalar joins and loop-carried changes, native/web default/release, all existing cross-host, debugger and runtime tests.

implementation: The checker logs only newly invalidated aliases and rolls back first-arm changes for sibling checking, then merges invalidations. The optimizer recognizes one conditional incoming edge plus a final register copy and an outgoing unconditional edge using at most 17 preceding instructions; it restores only that register version and queues invalidation at the outgoing edge target. No full-state snapshots or additional whole-function pass. OptControl replaces the previous parallel control arrays.
scope_limits: This is sibling isolation with conservative post-join invalidation, not a full reachability-sensitive narrowing system. It does not resolve all prior assignment/narrowing or loop-lifetime limitations. Tree lookup remains behind C. No baseline is accepted or ratcheted.
